shadow:
There is a difference between hearing a thing and letting it land. Hearing is the room doing its job, the ear catching whatever moves the air. Letting it land takes more of you, and it takes a kind of quiet most days do not have. When the quiet is gone, the only frequency that gets through is the bad one.

Discord is that narrowed reception. The talk happens, the news happens, the person across the table happens, and only the heavy part of it registers. The body keeps a long ledger. It carries every place a trust was broken, your own and your grandmother's and the species', and it reads each new thing against that ledger first. So the verdict is already in before the sentence is finished. People hear this as realism. They call it knowing how the world works.

Underneath the verdict is a quieter ache, a sense that the good outcome was never really on the table. That ache is not a flaw to scrub out. It is the ear straining. It means some part of you still expects there is a truer signal coming, and is hurt that it cannot find it. The strain itself is the start of the listening.
repressive: Some people answer the discord by agreeing with everyone. They nod, they soften, they let whatever is said pass straight through without touching them. It reads as kindness. Nothing has actually been taken in.
reactive: Others answer it by hardening. They argue every point, distrust every face, build a whole way of living out of being against. It reads as strength. They are bracing so hard against the bad signal that no signal reaches them at all.
gift:
Something shifts when a person stops sorting the world into threats and starts listening to themselves first. Before the verdict on the other person, there is a feeling in your own belly, and that feeling came with you. Catch it, watch it move, and the next thing you hear from someone else arrives without your fear stapled to it.

That catching is discernment. It is a finer grade of hearing, the kind that picks up the note under the note. Someone speaks and you take in the words, but also the worry the words are managing, the hope they are too shy to say plainly.

With this comes a strange relief about your own past. The things that happened to you, which used to look like bad luck dropped at random, start to show a shape. Not a comforting shape. A readable one. You begin to see your life the way old stories run, the dark stretch always sitting before the turn. And once you hear that pattern in your own years, you start to hear it in everyone, which makes the world feel less like a fight and more like a long piece of music you are finally inside of.
siddhi:
Listen long enough and deep enough and the listener thins out. There stops being a you on one side taking in a world on the other. The space between the ear and the thing heard closes. What is left is empathy, and empathy is not feeling sorry for someone from across a gap. The gap is the thing that goes.

To be inside another life this way is older than sympathy and stranger. You do not picture their pain, you are standing in it, and it does not break you, because at this frequency there is no separate self left to break. The whole human family turns out to share one nervous system, and you are awake inside it.

From here the discord makes sense at last. That long stretch of hearing only the heavy frequency was not deafness. It was the ear being tuned. The species keeps a record of everything it has lived, and someone has to be quiet enough to read it back. The ache that started all of this was always love, listening for itself in the dark.
